summary_bullets: Focus: Decoding the regulatory programs governing glioblastoma plasticity.
Glioblastoma is incurable and resistant to therapy despite genomic stability under treatment 1-8 , suggesting that non-genetic cellular plasticity is a central driver of progression.
Whether such plasticity reflects stochastic state switching or is governed by predictable gene regulation has remained unclear 9-13.
